# Layer A section headings — checked-in baseline for smoke step [11].
#
# Regenerate deliberately when a section is genuinely renamed or retired:
#   grep -h '^## ' rules/*.md | LC_ALL=C sort -u
#
# LC_ALL=C is not optional. Under en_US.UTF-8 collation `sort -u` considers
# several of these Korean headings equal and drops them: the first version of
# this file held 11 of 16 for exactly that reason, and the check that was
# supposed to catch it used the same pipeline, so both were wrong the same way.
